subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is **the.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The" **is a definite article and it refers to **the particular effect** of listening to Mozart.
 
• The complete sentence is: "**Unfortunately, the effect is temporary."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A definite article is used to refer to some particular object.
 
 
• **Example:** *I want the black book from the self.*
 
 
 
• *​*While indefinite article like "a" or "an" doesn't refer to any particular thing.
 
 
• **Example**- *I want a book from the self.*
 
• Here the book can be any book on the self.
